synthesis.body: Both pytest default norecursedirs and typical ruff excludes carry the bare name "build". A suite at tests/build/ is skipped on recursion — `pytest tests/` reports green having collected none of it — and naming the directory as an explicit argument does not rescue it; only naming individual files does. It also never gets linted. Measured on one move: 587 tests and 73 lint violations silently absent. Name it something else (tests/build_pipeline/). The same bare name in a ruff exclude also hides a package genuinely named build/ from every repo-root run.

title: A test directory named `build` is invisible to pytest and ruff
